displayName: OCI-AI-GOV-003: AI — Governance — Missing Transparency Requirements
description:
Detects AI system operations lacking required transparency disclosures per EU AI Act Article 13

⚠️ NEEDS-REWRITE: Query is generic SQL, needs conversion to Cloud Guard detector condition

dataSourceDetails.query: SELECT "siem_general_ai_gov_003", "data__json.rEventName" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'AuditEvents' AND "data__json.rEventName" LIKE '%governance%' AND "value" > 0
